sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报 DealBook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市的 DealBook 峰会现场采访商界、政界和文化界最具影响力的一些领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以直接观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的真实对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将于11月18日在 nytimes.com 上免费直播精选采访，供所有人观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得一个月的免费权限阅读我们所有的报道。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望大家准时收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, the Prime Minister of
sentences.zh: 今天，澳大利亚总理

sentences.en: Australia is calling for a high-level investigation into how the country's government has responded to the devastating wildfires there.
sentences.zh: 正呼吁对该国政府如何应对当地毁灭性的野火进行高层调查。

sentences.en: My colleague, Livia Albeck-Ripka, on the events that led up to this moment.
sentences.zh: 我的同事莉维亚·阿尔贝克-里普卡将讲述导致这一时刻的事件。

sentences.en: It's Monday, January 13th.
sentences.zh: 今天是1月13日，星期一。

sentences.en: Livia, you're on the ground in Australia covering these wildfires that have been raging throughout the continent.
sentences.zh: 莉维亚，你正身处澳大利亚现场，报道这些肆虐整个大陆的野火。

sentences.en: What have you been seeing these past few weeks?
sentences.zh: 这几周你都看到了什么？

sentences.en: So the scenes that are unfolding here in Australia are totally unprecedented.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚目前正在发生的场景可以说是史无前例的。

sentences.en: You know, we do have bushfires here in Australia, but what we're seeing now has not happened before.
sentences.zh: 你知道，澳大利亚确实常有林火，但我们现在看到的景象是从未发生过的。

sentences.en: It's been labelled the worst fire season ever recorded, an apocalypse, a nightmare, and like looking into the gates of hell.
sentences.zh: 它被称为有记录以来最严重的火灾季、一场末日浩劫、一场噩梦，就像窥视地狱之门。

sentences.en: This has been the hottest and driest year on record in Australia.
sentences.zh: 这是澳大利亚有记录以来最热、最干旱的一年。

sentences.en: Several bushfires burning outside of Sydney have combined into what's being called a mega blaze.
sentences.zh: 悉尼郊外燃起的多处林火已经合并成了被称为“超级大火”的火情。

sentences.en: It's not really one large fire, but hundreds, if not thousands, of smaller fires that started across various states along the southeastern coast of Australia.
sentences.zh: 它其实不是一场大火，而是数百甚至数千场小火，在澳大利亚东南海岸的各个州同时燃起。

sentences.en: They travelled down the coast, just becoming more immense and ferocious.
sentences.zh: 它们沿着海岸蔓延，变得越来越猛烈和凶悍。

sentences.en: Officials Friday warned the bushfire was too big to put out.
sentences.zh: 官员们在周五警告称，这场林火大到根本无法扑灭。

sentences.en: There were over 100 fires burning in the state.
sentences.zh: 州内有超过100处起火点。

sentences.en: And so these fires have created smog and smoke haze.
sentences.zh: 这些火灾产生了大量的烟雾和灰霾。

sentences.en: Sydney's skyline is renowned for being one of the most beautiful in the world, but it was far from its best today.
sentences.zh: 悉尼的天际线历来以全球最美之一著称，但今天它的状态远算不上好。

sentences.en: You probably saw images of the harbour totally covered in smoke.
sentences.zh: 你可能看到过整个港口完全被烟雾笼罩的照片。

sentences.en: That iconic Sydney harbour view that we all know and love virtually made invisible by this thick smoke haze.
sentences.zh: 我们熟悉并热爱的悉尼港标志性景观，几乎被这厚厚的浓烟完全遮蔽了。

sentences.en: In Canberra, the air pollution was recorded as the worst in the world, worse than Delhi even.
sentences.zh: 堪培拉的空气污染被记录为全球最严重，甚至比德里还要糟。

sentences.en: Pollution's levels in some parts are more than 17 times above hazardous levels, while major landmarks, including Parliament
sentences.zh: 某些地区的污染水平超过危险标准的17倍以上，而包括议会

sentences.en: House, are barely visible through the smoke.
sentences.zh: 大厦在内的主要地标在浓烟中若隐若现。

sentences.en: And some estimates put these fires at more than eight times larger than those in California that wiped out the town of Paradise.
sentences.zh: 据一些估计，这场大火的规模是加州那场摧毁了天堂镇的火灾的八倍以上。

sentences.en: Emergency officials warned that for some communities, if they wait too long, they might not be able to get out.
sentences.zh: 应急官员警告说，对于一些社区来说，如果他们等待太久，可能就无法撤离了。

sentences.en: They've destroyed nearly 2,000 homes at this point.
sentences.zh: 目前，大火已经摧毁了近2000栋房屋。

sentences.en: Residents are coming to terms with shuttered livelihoods.
sentences.zh: 居民们不得不接受生计被毁的现实。

sentences.en: The amount of work that was put into this place to make it the home it is, and then to lose it in one night with a fire.
sentences.zh: 为了把这里建成这样的家园，人们付出了大量的心血，却在一夜之间被一场大火夺走。

sentences.en: Nationally, 28 people have lost their lives.
sentences.zh: 在全国范围内，已有28人丧生。

sentences.en: Thousands of people have had to evacuate their homes and are camping in these relief centres.
sentences.zh: 数千人不得不撤离家园，并在救灾中心露营。

sentences.en: They don't know if their homes are standing or not standing.
sentences.zh: 他们不知道自己的房子是否还在。

sentences.en: It is now estimated that over one billion animals have been lost in wildfires burning out of control in Australia.
sentences.zh: 据现在估计，澳大利亚失控的野火已经导致超过十亿只动物丧生。

sentences.en: Those that are still out in the wild are desperate for water.
sentences.zh: 那些仍然留在野外的动物正极度渴望水源。

sentences.en: Volunteers are stepping in helping any way they can.
sentences.zh: 志愿者们纷纷站出来，尽其所能提供帮助。

sentences.en: So beyond the scale, what is so unique about these fires is they're threatening an entire ecosystem.
sentences.zh: 因此，除了规模巨大之外，这些火灾最独特的地方在于它们正在威胁着整个生态系统。

sentences.en: By some accounts, they've already wiped out at least half a billion animals.
sentences.zh: 据一些统计，它们已经消灭了至少五亿只动物。

sentences.en: Lidia, of all the devastation that you just described, that figure is especially striking.
sentences.zh: 莉迪亚，在你刚刚描述的所有满目疮痍中，这个数字尤其惊人。

sentences.en: It's almost hard to fathom half a billion animals dying from these fires.
sentences.zh: 几乎很难想象有五亿只动物死于这些火灾。

sentences.en: How is that possible?
sentences.zh: 这怎么可能呢？

sentences.en: So what you have to understand about Australia is that we have this incredibly unique ecosystem.
sentences.zh: 所以你必须明白，澳大利亚拥有极其独特的生态系统。

sentences.en: There are hundreds of species of animals that are endemic, so only found in Australia,
sentences.zh: 这里有数百种特有动物，也就是说只在澳大利亚才能找到，

sentences.en: which include, you know, koalas, kangaroos, possums, wallabies, cockatoos, and many other types of bugs and other species.
sentences.zh: 其中包括考拉、袋鼠、负鼠、沙袋鼠、凤头鹦鹉，以及许多其他种类的昆虫和其他物种。

sentences.en: And increasingly, as we've built up the landscape, they've been pushed into these dense parts of bush and that's what's burning.
sentences.zh: 而且随着我们不断开发土地，它们越来越多地被挤压到这些茂密的灌木丛中，而这正是现在正在燃烧的地方。

sentences.en: And what that means is that entire species of some of these animals could be wiped out in what some ecologists have described as a kind of biological Armageddon.
sentences.zh: 这意味着其中一些动物的整个物种可能会被消灭，生态学家将其描述为一种“生物学上的世界末日”。

sentences.en: In Australia, over the past few weeks, hundreds of koalas have been killed and large swaths of their habitat destroyed by raging bushfires.
sentences.zh: 在过去的几周里，澳大利亚数百只考拉丧生，它们的大片栖息地被肆虐的林火摧毁。

sentences.en: We're seeing images of singed koalas, dehydrated koalas and kangaroos emerging from the bush.
sentences.zh: 我们看到从灌木丛中逃出的考拉身上带着烧焦的痕迹，考拉和袋鼠都极度脱水。

sentences.en: Scores of people doing their best to rescue as many kangaroos, koalas, and other animals from the charred landscape.
sentences.zh: 大批民众正尽最大努力从焦黑的土地上营救尽可能多的袋鼠、考拉和其他动物。

sentences.en: And one thing I was really interested in finding was someone who was coming face to face with this massive destruction of Australia's ecosystem.
sentences.zh: 我真的很想找到一个能够直面澳大利亚生态系统这场巨大毁灭的人。

sentences.en: So last week, I drove out to Raymond Island in the southeastern part of the country to meet a woman
sentences.zh: 所以上周，我开车前往该国东南部的雷蒙德岛，去见一位名叫

sentences.en: named Susan Paulus, who's been going to great lengths to save these animals whose lives and habitats are being destroyed.
sentences.zh: 苏珊·保罗斯的女性，她一直在竭尽全力拯救这些生命和栖息地正被摧毁的动物。

sentences.en: I show up to this house on the island.
sentences.zh: 我来到岛上的这栋房子前。

sentences.en: Susie is staying at a friend's place.
sentences.zh: 苏茜正借住在朋友家。

sentences.en: The house is in disarray.
sentences.zh: 屋子里一片混乱。

sentences.en: Her daughter's there, her friend's there.
sentences.zh: 她的女儿在，她的朋友也在。

sentences.en: There's a lot of things going on, kind of a manic energy.
sentences.zh: 有很多事情在发生，有一种狂热的能量。

sentences.en: And there's this smell of hay and animals.
sentences.zh: 空气中弥漫着干草和动物的气味。

sentences.en: And I go in and have a look in the living room and there are all these joeys, baby kangaroos.
sentences.zh: 我走进去看了看起居室，里面全都是小袋鼠。

sentences.en: Have you ever had joeys in your living room before?
sentences.zh: 你以前在起居室里养过小袋鼠吗？

sentences.en: Never.
sentences.zh: 从来没有。

sentences.en: No, this is a firSt. There's blankets and hay on the floor.
sentences.zh: 没有，这是第一次。地上铺着毯子和干草。

sentences.en: And so we're sitting in this living room with kangaroos.
sentences.zh: 于是我们和袋鼠一起坐在起居室里。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 呵。

sentences.en: One of them's poking its head out and having a look around.
sentences.zh: 其中一只探出头来四处张望。

sentences.en: So the first one that you've got here...
sentences.zh: 所以你这里的这只第一只……

sentences.en: That's Pluto.
sentences.zh: 那是普鲁托。

sentences.en: And this is Riley.
sentences.zh: 这是莱利。

sentences.en: And so he's about eight months.
sentences.zh: 它大约八个月大。

sentences.en: I mean, so that's obviously not these animals' natural habitat.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这显然不是这些动物的自然栖息地。

sentences.en: So how did they end up in this living room?
sentences.zh: 那么它们是怎么来到这个起居室的呢？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So they normally live at a wildlife shelter that Susie runs, which is about 30 miles inland in the bush.
sentences.zh: 它们通常住在苏茜经营的一个野生动物庇护所里，该庇护所位于内陆大约30英里的灌木丛中。

sentences.en: Because what Susie does for a living is she rehabilitates and releases animals that have been orphaned or injured back into the wild.
sentences.zh: 因为苏茜的生计就是救助并放归那些成为孤儿或受伤后重返大自然的动物。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And she starts to tell us the story of these fires.
sentences.zh: 她开始给我们讲起这些火灾的故事。

sentences.en: Evacuating the animals was certainly challenging at the time because we knew the fire was burning and...
sentences.zh: 当时撤离动物肯定是个挑战，因为我们知道火势正在蔓延，而且……

sentences.en: A few weeks ago, she starts hearing that this bushfire is approaching her house.
sentences.zh: 几周前，她开始听到林火正在逼近她的房子。

sentences.en: It's getting closer and closer.
sentences.zh: 火势越来越近。

sentences.en: But it's not so close that the authorities are telling her to evacuate.
sentences.zh: 但还没近到让当局通知她撤离的地步。

sentences.en: They said it would be okay to stay the night and go the next morning.
sentences.zh: 他们说留宿一晚，第二天早上再走是可以的。

sentences.en: And then Susie and her daughter, who's 11, are outside and they look at the horizon and they see this weird orange glow.
sentences.zh: 然后苏茜和她11岁的女儿在外面，她们看着地平线，看到了这种诡异的橙色光芒。

sentences.en: And at that point, we're standing out there and you could see the glow right around the whole ridge.
sentences.zh: 就在那个时候，我们站在那里，你能看到整个山脊周围都有火光。

sentences.en: Her daughter asks her, is that the fire?
sentences.zh: 她的女儿问她，那是火吗？

sentences.en: Lily made a comment to say, mum, is that the fire?
sentences.zh: 莉莉评论说，妈妈，那是火吗？

sentences.en: Is the fire there?
sentences.zh: 火在那里吗？

sentences.en: And I said, no, no.
sentences.zh: 我说，没有，没有。

sentences.en: And Susie says, no, no, no.
sentences.zh: 苏茜说，不，不，不。

sentences.en: That would be way too close.
sentences.zh: 那可太近了。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So they go back into the house.
sentences.zh: 于是她们回到了屋里。

sentences.en: They start getting ready for bed.
sentences.zh: 她们开始准备睡觉。

sentences.en: And then Susie gets a call.
sentences.zh: 然后苏茜接到一个电话。

sentences.en: It's the CFA, which is the state fire authority.
sentences.zh: 是州消防局（CFA）打来的。

sentences.en: I've got a phone call at 1.30 in the morning from the CFA to tell me shit's happening.
sentences.zh: 我在凌晨1点30分接到 CFA 的电话，告诉我出大事了。

sentences.en: And they tell her the fire is approaching.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉她火势正在逼近。

sentences.en: You know, you either stay now, bunker down for this big fire front, or you're going to have to go now.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你要么现在留下，坚守阵地迎击这个巨大的火头，要么现在就得走。

sentences.en: And that's when it clicks.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，她反应过来了。

sentences.en: That red glow she saw, it was the fire.
sentences.zh: 她看到的红光，就是大火。

sentences.en: So we were just like, whoa.
sentences.zh: 所以我们当时就像，哇。

sentences.en: The next I ran and started evacuating animals.
sentences.zh: 接下来我跑出去开始疏散动物。

sentences.en: They wrap the kangaroos in blankets, put the koalas in baskets, put the chickens in boxes, and they drive down in this bizarre convoy.
sentences.zh: 她们用毯子裹住袋鼠，把考拉放进篮子里，把鸡装进箱子里，然后开着这个奇特的车队下山。

sentences.en: The total number that you evacuated with, 11 koalas, 15 kangaroos.
sentences.zh: 你撤离时带的总数是，11只考拉，15只袋鼠。

sentences.en: Yeah, um, two possuMs.
sentences.zh: 对，嗯，两只负鼠。

sentences.en: Two possuMs.
sentences.zh: 两只负鼠。

sentences.en: One bird.
sentences.zh: 一只鸟。

sentences.en: 11 koalas, 15 kangaroos, possums, a lorikeet, two dogs, chickens.
sentences.zh: 11只考拉，15只袋鼠，负鼠，一只彩虹吸蜜鹦鹉，两只狗，鸡。

sentences.en: That's all I've got, I think.
sentences.zh: 我想我就只有这些了。

sentences.en: I think that's it.
sentences.zh: 我想就是这样。

sentences.en: And they go down from the bush to the coast, to this island, where several of Susie's friends have agreed to house these animals while the fires are blazing.
sentences.zh: 然后她们从灌木丛下山来到海岸，来到这个岛上，苏茜的几个朋友同意在火灾肆虐期间收容这些动物。

sentences.en: So, Livia, how is everyone managing, especially the animals, being suddenly all together in this house?
sentences.zh: 那么，莉维亚，大家都是怎么应付的，尤其是这些动物突然全部挤在这栋房子里？

sentences.en: Well, it's not ideal.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这并不理想。

sentences.en: These animals are, they're wild animals.
sentences.zh: 这些动物是，它们是野生动物。

sentences.en: They're stressed.
sentences.zh: 它们很紧张。

sentences.en: They don't like being locked up in a bedroom.
sentences.zh: 它们不喜欢被关在卧室里。

sentences.en: And this is why Susie is really eager to get home.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么苏茜非常渴望回家。

sentences.en: And while I'm there, there's this lull in the fires.
sentences.zh: 就在我在那里的时候，火势出现了一段间歇。

sentences.en: And Susie decides this would be a good time to go back and check the property to assess the scale of the damage.
sentences.zh: 苏茜决定这正是回去检查房产、评估损失程度的好时机。

sentences.en: So, we hop into the car and we're driving out to her property.
sentences.zh: 于是，我们上车驱车前往她的房产。

sentences.en: We drive up this road, which is officially closed.
sentences.zh: 我们沿着一条官方已经封闭的道路向上开。

sentences.en: It's raining and the rain has turned the ash to this kind of sludge on the road.
sentences.zh: 外面在下雨，雨水把路上的灰烬变成了一种泥浆。

sentences.en: And we're driving through miles and miles of blackened foreSt.
sentences.zh: 我们穿行于数英里被烧焦的森林中。

sentences.en: How are you feeling seeing all of this?
sentences.zh: 看到这一切，你作何感想？

sentences.en: It's not.
sentences.zh: 这不对劲。

sentences.en: It's bad.
sentences.zh: 太糟糕了。

sentences.en: The eucalyptus trees don't have leaves on them.
sentences.zh: 桉树上没有叶子。

sentences.en: Some of them have fallen over.
sentences.zh: 有些树已经倒下了。

sentences.en: Susie rolls down the window to make sure that we hear the cracks of any trees that might fall over and hit the car.
sentences.zh: 苏茜摇下车窗，以确保我们能听到任何可能倒下并砸中汽车的树木的断裂声。

sentences.en: You've heard the sound of cracking timber before?
sentences.zh: 你以前听过木头断裂的声音吗？

sentences.en: I have.
sentences.zh: 听过。

sentences.en: Really?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: A tree fell down?
sentences.zh: 有树倒下了？

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Someone died one year.
sentences.zh: 有一年有人死了。

sentences.en: Oh my God.
sentences.zh: 噢天哪。

sentences.en: So, this is a pretty hairy drive.
sentences.zh: 所以，这是一段相当惊险的车程。

sentences.en: It's really slippery.
sentences.zh: 路非常滑。

sentences.en: The forest is totally decimated and there's an eerie smoke haze hanging over everything.
sentences.zh: 森林完全被毁，万物上方笼罩着一层诡异的烟霾。

sentences.en: At some point, we're at this turn in the road filled with managum trees, which is a type of eucalypt that have been totally decimated.
sentences.zh: 在某个时刻，我们来到了一个路口，这里长满了沼泽桉，这是一种被完全摧毁的桉树。

sentences.en: And Susie starts crying.
sentences.zh: 然后苏茜开始哭泣。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: This was her koala feed.
sentences.zh: 这是她给考拉准备的食物。

sentences.en: It was absolutely alive.
sentences.zh: 它们绝对是活的。

sentences.en: This is where she used to collect leaves for her animals that she was rehabilitating.
sentences.zh: 她以前就是在这里为她正在救助的动物们收集树叶。

sentences.en: And she doesn't know where she's going to get it from anymore.
sentences.zh: 而且她现在不知道还能从哪儿弄到这些。

sentences.en: So, even if she moves the animals back, she doesn't know how she'll feed them.
sentences.zh: 所以，即使她把动物们搬回来，她也不知道该怎么喂养它们。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: We continue driving to the property and her home.
sentences.zh: 我们继续开车前往这处房产和她的家。

sentences.en: And finally, we arrive and...
sentences.zh: 终于，我们抵达了，然后……

sentences.en: Look at this.
sentences.zh: 看这个。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Haltry green grass.
sentences.zh: 一片翠绿的草地。

sentences.en: It's incredible.
sentences.zh: 这太不可思议了。

sentences.en: It's like...
sentences.zh: 就像是……

sentences.en: It's like...
sentences.zh: 就像是……

sentences.en: It's just amazing.
sentences.zh: 简直太神奇了。

sentences.en: After miles and miles of burnt forest, we're finally in this place.
sentences.zh: 在经历了数英里又数英里的被烧毁的森林后，我们终于来到了这个地方。

sentences.en: And it's a lush, green oasis that has miraculously survived these fires.
sentences.zh: 这里是一处郁郁葱葱的绿色绿洲，奇迹般地在大火中幸存了下来。

sentences.en: Even Susie isn't quite sure how it's survived.
sentences.zh: 甚至连苏西也不太确定它是怎么幸存下来的。

sentences.en: She's somehow been spared.
sentences.zh: 不知怎么的，她逃過了一劫。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And one of the reasons is because there's been someone looking out for her land.
sentences.zh: 原因之一是有人一直在照看她的土地。

sentences.en: There's this friend.
sentences.zh: 有这么一位朋友。

sentences.en: Hey there.
sentences.zh: 你好啊。

sentences.en: Nice to meet you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴认识你。

sentences.en: This is Jason.
sentences.zh: 这是杰森。

sentences.en: He's the brave one.
sentences.zh: 他是那个勇敢的人。

sentences.en: A guy named Jason, who's stuck around, even when everyone else evacuated, even when the flames were yards high and threatening the property and his life.
sentences.zh: 一个名叫杰森的小伙子，他坚守了下来，甚至在其他人全部撤离时，甚至在火势高达几码并威胁到这处房产和他的生命时。

sentences.en: What was it like being here on your own, surrounded by fire in the bush?
sentences.zh: 独自一人待在这里，四周都是灌木丛大火，那是什么感觉？

sentences.en: That must have been terrifying.
sentences.zh: 那一定吓坏了吧。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Well, I had new moments.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我有过几个惊心动魄的时刻。

sentences.en: So, despite the evacuation notices, despite what the authorities were saying, Jason decided that he was going to stay and defend her property.
sentences.zh: 所以，尽管有撤离通知，尽管官方怎么说，杰森还是决定留下来保卫她的房产。

sentences.en: The flames here, like, they were up to here, you know, they were up the trees and...
sentences.zh: 这里的火焰，就像，它们有这么高，你知道的，它们蹿上了树，然后……

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: He's filling up a tanker with water.
sentences.zh: 他正在往水罐车里加水。

sentences.en: He's got a hose and a pump and he's desperately trying to ward off these flames, which are metres high.
sentences.zh: 他拿着水管和水泵，拼命地想要挡住这些几米高的火焰。

sentences.en: Because I just didn't want these trees to fall because they're so tall.
sentences.zh: 因为我就是不想让这些树倒下，它们太高了。

sentences.en: He's frantically trying to protect Susie's property, this place where she keeps these animals, when it just becomes too much.
sentences.zh: 他拼命地想要保护苏西的房产，也就是她寄养这些动物的地方，直到火势大得实在无法控制。

sentences.en: Were you afraid to be all right?
sentences.zh: 你当时害怕得要命吗？

sentences.en: I was a little, just because I didn't know what it was going to do.
sentences.zh: 我有点害怕，只是因为我不知道火势会发展成什么样。

sentences.en: It was scary.
sentences.zh: 太可怕了。

sentences.en: And at the last minute, he hears this sound.
sentences.zh: 就在最后一刻，他听到了这个声音。

sentences.en: Then I heard a helicopter and he's just hovering around, hovering around and then he just stayed around and I was like, hmm, that's good.
sentences.zh: 然后我听到一架直升机，它在周围盘旋，盘旋，接着它就留在了附近，我想，嗯，这挺好。

sentences.en: And then all of a sudden I heard another helicopter.
sentences.zh: 然后突然我又听到另一架直升机。

sentences.en: It was another small one and then they both were hovering around and then, yeah, the big one turned up and...
sentences.zh: 那是另一架小型直升机，接着它们两个都在周围盘旋，然后，对，大直升机出现了，然后……

sentences.en: It's a water bomber, an aircraft that can drop massive amounts of water and one of these water bombers soaks her property and saves it.
sentences.zh: 这是一架消防飞机，一种能投掷大量水源的飞机，其中一架消防飞机喷洒了她的房产并挽救了它。

sentences.en: So you're the hero that defended the property.
sentences.zh: 所以你就是保卫这处房产的英雄。

sentences.en: How does it feel?
sentences.zh: 感觉怎么样？

sentences.en: Oh, it's good.
sentences.zh: 哦，感觉挺好。

sentences.en: Good to that it's still there, you know, that it's still here.
sentences.zh: 很高兴它还在，你知道的，它依然完好无损。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So she got incredibly lucky.
sentences.zh: 所以她极其幸运。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: But even now they're not completely in the clear.
sentences.zh: 但即使到现在，他们也并没有完全脱离危险。

sentences.en: There are still some spot fires.
sentences.zh: 仍然有一些零星的火点。

sentences.en: There's this one log that is just persistently on fire.
sentences.zh: 有根圆木一直在持续燃烧。

sentences.en: And even if Susie takes her animals back, she can't be sure that another fire won't come.
sentences.zh: 而且就算苏西把动物们带回来，她也不能确定不会再有另一场大火袭来。

sentences.en: And this time, maybe she won't be as lucky.
sentences.zh: 而这一次，也许她就没那么幸运了。

sentences.en: Olivia, you're describing a series of Good Samaritans who have risked a lot to save these animals.
sentences.zh: 奥莉维亚，你描述了一系列见义勇为的好心人，他们冒着巨大的风险来拯救这些动物。

sentences.en: But the problem, I have to imagine, is far greater than any number of Good Samaritans could possibly solve.
sentences.zh: 但我不得不想象，这个问题之大，绝非任何数量的好心人所能解决的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, these people are battling these immense changes to Australia's landscape on a tiny, tiny scale.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这些人正在以极小、极小的规模与澳大利亚地貌所发生的这种巨大变化作斗争。

sentences.en: And they can't save Australia's wildlife on their own.
sentences.zh: 他们无法凭一己之力拯救澳大利亚的野生动物。

sentences.en: But it is mainly volunteers who are battling these blazes and their impacts.
sentences.zh: 但与这些大火及其影响作斗争的主要是志愿者。

sentences.en: And that touches on a deep frustration throughout the country that I've seen in my reporting
sentences.zh: 这就触及了我在报道中看到的整个国家深切的挫败感

sentences.en: that it's falling on people like Jason, like Susie, to protect Australia in this disaster.
sentences.zh: 那就是保护这场灾难中的澳大利亚的重任落在了像杰森、像苏西这样的人身上。

sentences.en: And that the government of Australia isn't doing enough.
sentences.zh: 而澳大利亚政府做得还远远不够。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程式？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程式时，你在应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程式，即可获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So, Livia, you said that the work of fighting these enormous fires has really fallen on individuals like Susie, and that there's a sense that the government isn't doing enough.
sentences.zh: 那么，莉维亚，你刚才说抗击这些巨型火灾的工作实际上落在了像苏西这样的个人头上，而且人们觉得政府做得还不够。

sentences.en: So what exactly has the government been doing?
sentences.zh: 那么政府到底做了些什么？

sentences.en: So, a number of weeks ago, these posters of the Prime Minister, this man named Scott Morrison, began to pop up around Australia and online as a kind of meme.
sentences.zh: 所以，在几周前，这些关于总理、一个叫斯科特·莫里森的男人的海报开始在澳大利亚各地和网络上作为一种迷因涌现出来。

sentences.en: They said, missing.
sentences.zh: 上面写着，失踪。

sentences.en: Your country is on fire.
sentences.zh: 你的国家在燃烧。

sentences.en: The Prime Minister, Scott Morrison, is getting hammered tonight for quietly going on a holiday to Hawaii while large parts of the nation burn.
sentences.zh: 总理斯科特·莫里森今晚遭到猛烈抨击，因为在大片国土燃烧之际，他悄悄去夏威夷度假了。

sentences.en: It starts to emerge that maybe the Prime Minister is away on vacation.
sentences.zh: 开始有消息传出，总理可能外出度假了。

sentences.en: We don't really know where he is.
sentences.zh: 我们其实并不知道他在哪儿。

sentences.en: And then these pictures start to circulate online where he appears to be on the beach in
sentences.zh: 然后这些照片开始在网络上流传，照片中他似乎在夏威夷的

sentences.en: Hawaii.
sentences.zh: 海滩上。

sentences.en: Protesters will gather at the Prime Minister's Sydney residence this morning, claiming Scott
sentences.zh: 抗议者将于今早聚集在总理的悉尼官邸外，称斯科特

sentences.en: Morrison is missing in action.
sentences.zh: 莫里森擅离职守。

sentences.en: No, no, must, don't.
sentences.zh: 不，不，必须，别这样。

sentences.en: At a time when the country needs leadership on bushfires and smoke haze.
sentences.zh: 在国家需要对森林大火和烟霾进行领导的关键时刻。

sentences.en: And people are really pissed off.
sentences.zh: 人们真的气炸了。

sentences.en: I'm angry.
sentences.zh: 我很愤怒。

sentences.en: But it's not just about this vacation.
sentences.zh: 但不仅仅是因为这次度假。

sentences.en: I'm really angry that these people are denying, continuously denying climate change.
sentences.zh: 我真正愤怒的是这些人一直在否认，不断地否认气候变化。

sentences.en: What people are really upset about is the Prime Minister's attitude toward the environment and climate change and his beholdence to coal.
sentences.zh: 人们真正感到不满的是总理对环境和气候变化的态度，以及他对煤炭的依附。

sentences.en: And what exactly do you mean by that, his beholdence to coal?
sentences.zh: 你这话到底是什么意思，他对煤炭的依附？

sentences.en: So, Australia has always had this really intimate relationship with coal.
sentences.zh: 所以，澳大利亚一直与煤炭有着这种非常密切的关系。

sentences.en: We're the world's largest exporter of it.
sentences.zh: 我们是世界上最大的煤炭出口国。

sentences.en: The government is highly supported by the coal industry.
sentences.zh: 政府得到了煤炭行业的大力支持。

sentences.en: And both parties take donations from the coal industry.
sentences.zh: 而且两大政党都接受来自煤炭行业的捐款。

sentences.en: So, there's this intimate connection between coal and government in Australia.
sentences.zh: 因此，在澳大利亚，煤炭与政府之间存在着这种密不可分的联系。

sentences.en: It's a part of our identity and has been for a long time.
sentences.zh: 它是我们身份的一部分，而且已经持续了很长时间。

sentences.en: But increasingly, there's this climate war growing in Australia where, because we're one of the most vulnerable developed nations to the impacts of climate change, people are
sentences.zh: 但越来越明显的是，澳大利亚正在爆发一场气候战争，因为我们是受气候变化影响最脆弱的发达国家之一，人们

sentences.en: increasingly growing tired of this connection to coal.
sentences.zh: 对这种煤炭纽带越来越感到厌倦。

sentences.en: We are living in a dangerous climate and it is time for our Prime Minister to get out of
sentences.zh: 我们生活在一个危险的气候环境中，我们的总理是时候摆脱

sentences.en: pockets of the coal and gas lobby groups and to start thinking about the future of Australians.
sentences.zh: 煤炭和天然气游说集团的口袋，开始考虑澳大利亚人的未来了。

sentences.en: But on the other side, we do have those who still believe that it's integral to our identity, that the economy would collapse if we didn't have it.
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，我们确实也有这样的人，他们仍然认为这不可或缺地构成了我们的身份，如果没有它，经济就会崩溃。

sentences.en: 55,000 jobs depend on our coal mining industry.
sentences.zh: 5.5万个工作岗位依赖于我们的煤炭开采业。

sentences.en: And as far as the Prime Minister goes, he's certainly on the side of the coal industry.
sentences.zh: 就总理而言，他当然是站在煤炭行业这一边的。

sentences.en: I'm not going to support those running around Queensland trying to steal people's jobs.
sentences.zh: 我不会支持那些在昆士兰州四处奔走、企图抢走人们饭碗的人。

sentences.en: And how has this climate debate going on in Australia and the Prime Minister's approach to it factored into how he has responded to these fires?
sentences.zh: 那么，澳大利亚正在进行的这场气候辩论以及总理对此采取的方法，是如何影响他对这些火灾做出反应的呢？

sentences.en: So when these fires start in September, Mr. Morrison is really slow to respond.
sentences.zh: 所以当这些火灾在9月份爆发时，莫里森先生的反应非常迟钝。

sentences.en: I would like to go and provide direct personal support to people as they're suffering.
sentences.zh: 我愿意去为遭受苦难的人们提供直接的个人支持。

sentences.en: But at the same time, we don't want to hamper or in any way frustrate the firefighting effort and the support efforts that are in place.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，我们不想妨碍或以任何方式干扰已经部署的消防工作和支援工作。

sentences.en: So there's no federal government response really at all.
sentences.zh: 所以联邦政府实际上根本没有什么反应。

sentences.en: And the way that Australia fights fires is primarily with volunteers.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚抗击火灾的方式主要是依靠志愿者。

sentences.en: And as these fires become more and more intense, these firefighters are becoming fatigued.
sentences.zh: 随着这些火灾愈演愈烈，这些消防员也变得精疲力竭。

sentences.en: But the Prime Minister says he's not going to pay them.
sentences.zh: 但总理表示他不会付给他们薪水。

sentences.en: Australia is very well placed in position to deal with these types of disasters.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚在应对此类灾害方面处于非常有利的地位。

sentences.en: The coordination and the relationships that have been built up between our state agencies is simply outstanding.
sentences.zh: 我们的州级机构之间建立的协调和关系简直堪称卓越。

sentences.en: And I've seen it on display.
sentences.zh: 我亲眼目睹了这一点。

sentences.en: He says this is an issue for the states and not the federal government.
sentences.zh: 他说这是各州的问题，而不是联邦政府的问题。

sentences.en: Public anger has risen after two volunteer firefighters were killed battling bushfires sweeping the East CoaSt.
sentences.zh: 在两名志愿消防员在扑救席卷东海岸的森林大火时殉职后，公众的愤怒情绪高涨。

sentences.en: Then two firefighters die.
sentences.zh: 接着两名消防员牺牲了。

sentences.en: Heartbreaking scene as their colleagues comfort each other in a time of incredible sadness.
sentences.zh: 令人心碎的场景，他们的同事在这个极其悲伤的时刻互相安慰。

sentences.en: So word gets out that the Prime Minister's on this vacation in Hawaii.
sentences.zh: 于是有消息传出，总理正在夏威夷度假。

sentences.en: The Prime Minister has caved tonight, rushing back from Hawaii amid criticism for taking a holiday while Sydney burns.
sentences.zh: 在因悉尼燃烧期间度假而遭受批评后，总理今晚终于妥协，从夏威夷匆忙赶回。

sentences.en: And he finally holds a press conference.
sentences.zh: 他终于举行了一场新闻发布会。

sentences.en: I want to start by extending my sincere condolences and sympathies once again.
sentences.zh: 我要首先再次致以最诚挚的哀悼和同情。

sentences.en: He agrees to pay the volunteer firefighters $6,000 Australian dollars each.
sentences.zh: 他同意向每位志愿消防员支付6000澳元。

sentences.en: I also want to acknowledge the outstanding work that is being done.
sentences.zh: 我还想感谢所做出的卓越工作。

sentences.en: And he does this really big thing.
sentences.zh: 而且他做出了一件非常大的举措。

sentences.en: The HEMS Adelaide, the Navy's largest amphibious ship, has been readied to join the HEMS Charles
sentences.zh: “阿德莱德”号两栖攻击舰（HEMS Adelaide）——海军最大的两栖舰船，已做好准备，将与“查尔斯·沙尔斯”号（HEMS Charles Chulls）以及“西卡莫尔”号（MV Sycamore）一起，协助从我们海岸线受火灾影响的地区撤离公民。

sentences.en: Chulls and the MV Sycamore in supporting evacuation of citizens from fire affected areas along our coastline.
sentences.zh: 查尔斯和“西卡莫尔”号一起支援从我们海岸线受火灾影响地区撤离公民。

sentences.en: He says he's going to deploy the Navy to evacuate people.
sentences.zh: 他说他要派遣海军去撤离民众。

sentences.en: The best response I can provide to people who are feeling angry and people who are feeling isolated, for people who are fearful and afraid, is to do what I'm doing today.
sentences.zh: 我能向感到愤怒、感到孤立、感到恐惧和害怕的人们提供的最佳回应，就是去做我今天正在做的事情。

sentences.en: And some say this is the biggest maritime evacuation Australia has ever seen.
sentences.zh: 有人说这是澳大利亚见过的最大规模的海上疏散行动。

sentences.en: And since returning from this unfortunately timed vacation and really engaging with the response to these fires,
sentences.zh: 自从从这次时间尴尬的假期中归来并真正投入到应对这些火灾的工作中以来，

sentences.en: what has the Prime Minister said about the connection between the fires and climate change?
sentences.zh: 总理对火灾与气候变化之间的联系说了些什么？

sentences.en: As these fires have intensified, and so has the pressure from the public and from journalists, he's been forced to address climate change head on.
sentences.zh: 随着这些火灾的加剧，公众和记者的压力也随之增大，他被迫正面应对气候变化问题。

sentences.en: There is no argument about the links between broader issues of global climate change and weather events around the world.
sentences.zh: 关于全球气候变化的更广泛问题与世界各地天气事件之间的联系，这是毋庸置疑的。

sentences.en: But I'm sure people equally would acknowledge that the direct connection to any single fire event, it's not a credible suggestion to make that link.
sentences.zh: 但我相信大家同样会承认，对于任何单一的火灾事件的直接联系，把这种联系说成是可信的建议是不合情理的。

sentences.en: And what he said is that he's always believed in climate change, but that it's impossible to link events like the bushfires to any one regulation or policy of a specific country.
sentences.zh: 而他的说法是，他一直相信气候变化，但把森林大火之类的事件与某个特定国家的某项法规或政策联系起来是不可能的。

sentences.en: So we must take action on climate change.
sentences.zh: 所以我们必须对气候变化采取行动。

sentences.en: And we'll do it without economy wrecking or job destroying reckless targets.
sentences.zh: 并且我们将在不制定破坏经济或毁灭就业的鲁莽目标的情况下做到这一点。

sentences.en: We'll do it with sensible targets that gets the balance right.
sentences.zh: 我们将通过明智的目标来实现平衡。

sentences.en: And so there's this real divide here between those who see the bushfires in Australia as some kind of natural disaster, as a tragedy,
sentences.zh: 因此，这里存在着真正的分歧：一方将澳大利亚的森林大火视为某种自然灾害、一场悲剧，

sentences.en: and those who see it as a turning point in the conversation about climate change.
sentences.zh: 而另一方则将其视为气候变化对话中的一个转折点。

sentences.en: Right, because a tragedy would not be preventable.
sentences.zh: 没错，因为悲剧是不可避免的。

sentences.en: It's just a horrible thing that you experience and you mourn.
sentences.zh: 那只是一件你所经历并为之哀悼的可怕事情。

sentences.en: Whereas a turning point in the case of these fires implies that what's being mourned here becomes a call to action to prevent this from happening again.
sentences.zh: 鉴于这场山火的一个转折点意味着，在这里哀悼的一切都化为了采取行动的号召，以防止这种情况再次发生。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think for those people who are experiencing these impacts firsthand
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为对于那些亲身经历这些影响的人来说，

sentences.en: and for those who are watching them play out online on their TVs around Australia, this is one of the first times we're really experiencing as a country
sentences.zh: 以及对于那些在澳大利亚各地通过电视和网络亲眼目睹这一幕的人来说，这是我们作为国家第一次真正体验到

sentences.en: what climate change feels and looks like, just how apocalyptic it can be and just how much our ecosystems can be devastated.
sentences.zh: 气候变化的感觉和面貌是什么样的，它是多么具有世界末日般的景象，我们的生态系统又受到了多么严重的破坏。

sentences.en: And so for these people, they're really hoping that this is a moment where the government is finally going to act and change its policies around this issue.
sentences.zh: 因此，对于这些人来说，他们真的很希望这是一个时刻，让政府最终采取行动并改变其在这个问题上的政策。

sentences.en: Livia, how much more can we expect from these fires?
sentences.zh: 莉维亚，我们预计这场山火还会持续多久？

sentences.en: And as Australia tries to put them out,
sentences.zh: 在澳大利亚试图扑灭大火的同时，

sentences.en: have people like Susie been able to return to their homes and basically start rebuilding their lives?
sentences.zh: 像苏西这样的人能够返回家园并基本上开始重建生活了吗？

sentences.en: So since I visited Susie and there was this little lull in the fires, it's picked back up again and whatever small amount of rain fell,
sentences.zh: 自从我拜访苏西以来，山火曾有过短暂的平息，但现在又卷土重来，无论降下了多么少量的雨水，

sentences.en: authorities are saying, really made no difference to the fires that are continuing to rage all along the coaSt.
sentences.zh: 当局表示，对于一直在沿海肆虐的山火来说，真的没有起到什么作用。

sentences.en: And we've got weeks, if not months, left of them.
sentences.zh: 而且我们还要应对数周甚至数月的时间。

sentences.en: Livia, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 莉维亚，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: I think there's obviously a need for a national review of the response.
sentences.zh: 我认为显然有必要对应对工作进行全国性审查。

sentences.en: And let's not forget the Royal Commission, is that what you're talking about?
sentences.zh: 别忘了皇家调查委员会，你说的就是这个吗？

sentences.en: I think that is what would be necessary, and I'll be taking a proposal through Cabinet to that end.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是必要的，我将为此向内阁提交一份提案。

sentences.en: In an interview on Sunday, Australian Prime Minister Scott Morrison said he would call for a high-level investigation into the government's handling of the country's bushfires,
sentences.zh: 在周日的一次采访中，澳大利亚总理斯科特·莫里森表示，他将呼吁对政府处理该国山火的方式进行高级别调查，

sentences.en: acknowledging the nation's deep frustration with the response.
sentences.zh: 承认全国上下对此反应深感沮丧。

sentences.en: But in the interview, Morrison did not call for a significant shift in his government's policies towards carbon emissions.
sentences.zh: 但在采访中，莫里森并没有呼吁对其政府关于碳排放的政策做出重大转变。

sentences.en: In the years ahead, we are going to continue to evolve our policy in this area to reduce emissions even further.
sentences.zh: 在未来的几年里，我们将继续在该领域完善我们的政策，以进一步减少排放。

sentences.en: And we're going to do it without a carbon tax, without putting up electricity prices.
sentences.zh: 我们将这样做，而不征收碳税，也不提高电价。

sentences.en: So do you do it without a carbon tax and putting up prices?
sentences.zh: 所以你们在不征收碳税和提高价格的情况下做到这一点？

sentences.en: And putting up and without shutting down traditional industries upon which regional Australians depend for their very livelihood.
sentences.zh: 以及在不关闭偏远地区澳大利亚人赖以维生的传统行业的情况下。

sentences.en: They do.
sentences.zh: 他们会的。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: After a deliberate delay, House Speaker Nancy Pelosi said she would transmit the articles of impeachment adopted by the House over to the Senate later this week,
sentences.zh: 在刻意拖延之后，众议院议长南希·佩洛西表示，她将于本周晚些时候把众议院通过的弹劾条款移交给参议院，

sentences.en: paving the way for the third presidential impeachment trial in U.S.
sentences.zh: 为美国历史上

sentences.en: history.
sentences.zh: 第三次总统弹劾审判铺平了道路。

sentences.en: Pelosi had wagered that delaying the transmission would pressure Republican Senate Majority Leader Mitch McConnell to hold a fairer trial with new witnesses.
sentences.zh: 佩洛西此前赌定，推迟移交会施压共和党参议院多数党领袖米奇·麦康奈尔，要求其允许新证人出席，从而进行一场更公正的审判。

sentences.en: But McConnell now says he has enough votes to begin a trial without allowing for such witnesses, undercutting Pelosi's strategy and forcing her hand.
sentences.zh: 但麦康奈尔现在表示，他拥有足够的票数来开始审判，而无需允许此类证人，这削弱了佩洛西的策略并逼迫她做出妥协。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日简报》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Bavaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴瓦罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周在《导购秀》上，我们正为假期招待客人家做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是不是喝到不省人事才去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的要求。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何播客平台上搜索《导购秀》。
